title: Solana Incubator Cohort 6
description: Solana Labs' incubator: 4 to 6 companies build in person with the Solana Labs team in New York City for 3 months starting March 2027, with a relocation stipend and support across development, go-to-market, fundraising, brand and networking. For existing Solana teams, Web3 teams considering Solana, and Web2 teams incorporating Web3.
reward: A relocation stipend for 3 months in New York City (amount not stated), plus development, go-to-market and fundraising support
summary: NYC incubator with relocation stipend, amount not stated · closes Dec 4
ideas: A live Solana product with growing users
A Web2 company adding onchain payments on Solana
A mobile app the Solana Mobile team could support
setup: commit every founder to move to NYC for 3 months
each_time: users, revenue, funds raised and runway
rules: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with early applicants prioritized. The final deadline is December 4; no time zone is stated, so EarnKit lists the end of December 4 New York time.
Cohort 6 starts March 2027 in New York City and lasts 3 months; founders build in person with the Solana Labs team. A relocation stipend is provided.
The incubator takes 4 to 6 teams across three profiles: existing Solana teams, Web3 teams considering Solana, and Web2 teams incorporating Web3.
Support covers hands-on development, fundraising, strategic collaborations, go-to-market, community building and content, ending in Demo Day presentations.
Several answers have stated limits: 400 characters for what the company does, 600 for each idea question, 300 for the most noteworthy fact.
